module: Flowgraph node 'And' (logic category). Only lets the flow through if all flow_1..flow_N inputs have flow. 2 inputs by default, the number is adjustable in the node properties (flow_i pins created/deleted dynamically). Output: flow pin. Runs every frame the graph is active.
notes: legacyPins: former inputs a and b renamed flow_1 and flow_2.
The C.todo field in the code plans an arbitrary number of inputs, already done via the Count property.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor properties panel: integer field 'Count' that changes the number of input pins (minimum 1). Returns the reason for the change.

updatePins.desc: Adds or deletes the flow_i input pins to go from old to new; also deletes the links that pointed to the removed pins.

work.desc: Sets the flow output to true only if all flow_1..flow_count inputs are true, otherwise false.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves count in the serialized data.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads count back (2 by default) and recreates the corresponding pins.
